description: Show the typing indicator in a channel or thread for 10 seconds, for a bot that needs a few seconds to prepare an answer. Discord advises most bots not to use it. To post the reply use discord_send_message. Bot permissions it may need: View Channel, Send Messages, Send Messages in Threads. Changes Discord data and is not idempotent; check the result before retrying.

channel_id.description: ID of the channel or thread to display typing indicator in

name: discord_trigger_typing_indicator
